_comment: 12 metered Pack products (one per m3ter meter on the Signicat/Wolt quotes), the CommitmentSpend product (v2 D10) and the customer-success fee (v2 D11). All EUR. The two country-priced checks allow configuration during sale so the seller picks the Country on the line.

records.Name: Document Check - Boost
records.Description: Metered verification check (m3ter meter `document_report_standard_hybrid`). List 2.28 EUR per check; the negotiated price is set per quote line. Priced per Country: one quote line per country (ANY / JPN / KAZ / SRB).

records.Name: Document Check - Flash
records.Description: Metered verification check (m3ter meter `document_report_standard_auto`). List 0.65 EUR per check; the negotiated price is set per quote line.

records.Name: Document Check - Sherlock
records.Description: Metered verification check (m3ter meter `document_report_standard_manual`). List 3.02 EUR per check; the negotiated price is set per quote line.

records.Name: Verification Spend Commitment (EUR)

records.Name: Customer Success Fee
records.Description: Annual customer-success fee. No list price (0.00); the seller prices it on the quote line. Renews with the contract.
